description: Two-year Treasury yield. Currently the seed-42 synthetic series; flips to FRED DGS2 at the live-market cutover.
Ten-year Treasury yield - the DCF risk-free benchmark per risk_free_policy. Synthetic until the live cutover (FRED DGS10).
Overnight policy rate. Context and scenario driver - never a direct WACC input (maturity mismatch).
Headline CPI inflation rate. NOTE: the synthetic series stores the RATE directly; the live layer ingests the CPIAUCSL index and derives YoY (auditable direction). Never plugs into WACC.
Headline unemployment. Demand/wage context for operating assumptions - never a WACC input.
Curve slope: positive = normal, near zero = flat, negative = inverted. Derived from the two tenor metrics; FRED T10Y2Y is a future cross-check only.
